meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会在实现完成后自己动手在真实界面做手工 QA 并留下证据，再启动一个（仅一个）gate reviewer 子代理，对照目标、约束、代码质量、安全与漏掉的上下文来审计整套改动。
howto.when: 在你准备做 PR 交接，或明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发。若手工 QA 有失败行，审查就此结束并报 REVIEW FAILED，不再启动评审代理。

say.text: 用 review-work 审一下刚做完的改动
say.note: 会先手工 QA，再启动一个 gate reviewer。

say.text: 明天要提 PR，先跑一遍 review-work 的 gate 审查
say.note: PR 交接前先过这道门。

say.text: 这次改动有没有漏掉上下文？用 review-work 查一下
say.note: 会连同 QA 证据一起交给评审代理。

howto.what_en: After implementation, Claude runs hands-on QA on the real surface itself and captures evidence, then launches exactly one gate reviewer sub-agent to audit the change set against goal, constraints, code quality, security, and missed context.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. If any manual QA row fails, the review stops there and no gate reviewer is launched.

say_en.text: Review what I just finished with review-work.
say_en.note: Runs manual QA first, then one gate reviewer.

say_en.text: I'm handing off a PR - run the review-work gate first.
say_en.note: Gate review happens before the PR handoff.

say_en.text: Use review-work to check whether any context was missed.
say_en.note: Sends the QA evidence along to one reviewer.
